messages.content: "microcheating" ei concept ta real jinis naki just overreact kora manush der

Eta real concept, kintu subjective o - couple ba couple e boundary alada hote pare. Core idea hocche choto choto action jeta explicit cheating na kintu emotional boundary cross kore, jemon secretly kauke follow kora ba flirt kora - choto lage, kintu pattern hole eta boro issue hoye dara.
